summary: Preserve unrelated dirty primary state during isolated ticket allocation

delivery.outcome: Allow isolated scoped allocation while preserving unrelated dirty primary changes.
nonGoals: Edit adopter packages before protected publication
Alter scope conflict, review or ownership policy
Clean or take over another writer checkout

architecture.decision: Reuse mandatory work-start admission for dirty-scope conflict detection; require explicit scope before permitting dirty primary allocation from committed target SHA.
architecture.rollback: Revert the allocator correction; preserve all previously allocated worktrees.

validation.evidence: Integration tests check staged/unstaged/untracked preservation and committed-base isolation.
Integration tests verify conflicting and unscoped requests reserve no identity.
Canonical worktree regressions and managed gate; protected exact-head checks required before merge.
